item.title: GUNS N’ ROSES Release Two Brand-New Songs ‘Nothin’ & ‘Atlas’
item.description: It’s finally here: Guns N’ Roses have officially released the two previously teased new tracks, “Nothin’” and “Atlas”. Both songs could very well make it onto their World Tour 2026 setlist, which includes two dates in Germany this summer: Tickets for these shows are still available via Live Nation.
